title: Make the Trade Journey list search answer within the readback budget at hosted volume

hosted_incident.error_message: Trade Journey list did not converge after bounded retries
hosted_incident.before_behaviour: Full q predicate with ILIKE '%q%' across journeys.journey_id, identity_links.identifier_value, and per-row jsonb_each / jsonb_array_elements_text expansions on current_identity_summary forced sequential table scans and repeated row expansions. Operator measurement on hosted DB showed COUNT(*) alone took 5,697 ms; page query and total count each ran the predicate, causing 20s transport timeouts over 4 retry attempts.
hosted_incident.after_behaviour: Exact journey_id queries resolve via primary key index scan on journeys_pkey (journey_id = q alone) in < 0.5 ms without evaluating subqueries or jsonpath. Exact identifier_value queries probe indexes and resolve via index-backed subquery with index scans on idx_identity_links_tenant_env_value_journey and idx_journeys_summary_gin, where the GIN index serves the jsonpath predicate via Bitmap Index Scan in ~0.04 ms. Substring search is index-backed by pg_trgm GIN indexes (idx_journeys_journey_id_trgm, idx_identity_links_value_trgm) without redundant per-row jsonb expansion. Ordered migrations are wired into bootstrap_schema so migration 002 is always applied during bootstrap.

gin_index_jsonpath_verification.bootstrap_wiring: Wired ordered forward-only migrations into bootstrap_schema() ensuring 002_add_trade_journey_search_indexes.sql is applied during schema bootstrap.

ac1_exact_lookup_index_backed.detail: Trade Journey list requests with q set to an exact journey id use journey_id = q alone on journeys_pkey (< 0.5 ms). Exact identifier queries use index-backed lookups on identity_links and summary GIN index.

ac2_substring_search_index_backed.detail: Substring search is index-backed using pg_trgm GIN indexes added via forward-only migration 002 applied via bootstrap_schema. Redundant per-row jsonb identity expansion was eliminated.

ac3_shared_predicate_page_and_count.detail: page_journeys builds base_clauses once and shares the identical predicate across both the count query and the paginated rows query.

ac4_explain_analyze_dataset_and_timing.detail: Measured on generated dataset of 38,639 journeys and 264,025 identity links via real bootstrap path. Exact journey ID query total latency is 0.21 ms (< 500 ms threshold); exact identifier is 0.99 ms; substring search is 30.16 ms.

ac5_readback_contract_preserved.detail: services/trade_journey/hosted_bff_readback.py is untouched: 20 second client timeout and readback contracts are fully preserved.

ac6_no_compressed_code.detail: Net production code change is +52 lines (+34 in bff trade_journey_projection_store.py, -1 in trade_journey projection_store.py, +19 in migration SQL), strictly within the 60 net line budget with standard clean multiline formatting.

ac7_hosted_track_external_wait.detail: Recorded as external_wait pending the next automatic dev pair release to verify Trade Journey list step of public BFF readback.
